clauses.content: Delivered apparel must be requested within {return_window_days} days after delivery (UTC); the boundary is inclusive.
Delivery is required: {requires_delivered}. Final-sale returns allowed: {allow_final_sale}. Duplicate returns are never allowed. Non-apparel is referred to simulated support.
Customer-reported resale requirements: {required_conditions}. Wearing alone is not disqualifying. Unknown conditions are never assumed good; this is not physical inspection.
When resale requirements fail, use these origin-specific actions: {origin_actions}. Never infer who caused a problem. Wrong-item and defect claims require human review.

An eligible case needs explicit confirmation to create a simulated RMA. Unresolved questions are collected into a simulated support ticket; no external agent is notified and no real refund is processed.
